locator: MDN Baseline compatibility glossary, last modified 2026-08-17; MDN testing strategy consulted for project-specific support matrices
summary: MDN describes Baseline as a current summary of web-feature availability across major desktop and mobile browsers and explicitly says it does not replace accessibility, usability, performance, security, older-device, web-view, or assistive-technology testing. Design DNA uses it for feature screening while requiring a project-specific browser, engine, OS, and real-device support contract.
